facts.fact: The Instituto Nacional de Estatísticas yearbook of vital statistics for 2018-2022 draws on paper civil-registration records of births, marriages and deaths held by the Ministry of Justice (databases sent to INE annually in Excel), with the RapidPro birth-registration platform, and on the DHIS2 health information system for deaths and causes; as_of is the document's published date (2022-01-01), the figures cover 2018-2022.
